label: STANDARD_OF_FAVOURING_2: the end-realization ordering
term: standard of favouring, end-realization sense (EndRealizationStandard fit)
definition: EndRealizationStandard fit ranks x over y at scenario s exactly when x realizes the end content D at s and y does not (fit s x = true and fit s y = false), the pattern of the Lane 2b fitOrder. It is the standard by which a favouring determined to the end content D is correct: such a favouring tracks it exactly. It ranks no two candidates that both realize, or both fail to realize, D.
note: Stipulative analyst notion (#2145 premise lane P), attribution deferred. It is not ORIGINAL_FINALITY_1, whose conditions include that the favoured arrangement is better (good s x y); it is only the ordering by end-realization.
